name: ExperiTome
tagline: Built on experience. Made for discovery.
description_en: An open-source research knowledge library connecting experience, protocols, public ExperiAtlas data resources, and analysis workflows. ExperiAtlas provides cross-species lookup and curated expression evidence; study-specific measurements remain with the user.
description_zh: ExperiTome从实际研究经验出发，连接实验方法、公开ExperiAtlas数据资源与分析流程；ExperiAtlas提供跨物种身份检索和精选表达证据，个人测量数据仍由使用者自行保管。

public_profile.bio_zh: 何帅涵现为香港科技大学（广州）生命科学与生物医学工程学域、脑与智能研究所博士生。研究兴趣包括群体遗传与地方猪遗传资源、计算蛋白质组学与多组学整合，以及脑衰老相关的分子机制。
public_profile.bio_en: Shuaihan He is a PhD student in the Bioscience and Biomedical Engineering Thrust and Brain and Intelligence Research Institute at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou). His interests include population genetics and indigenous pig resources, computational proteomics and multi-omics integration, and molecular mechanisms related to brain aging.
